title: Day 3 / 500 — ATS-Y1-003 Verify the Java main() Launcher Contract
subtitle: Use a real survey-import launch mode to investigate main-method behavior.

steps.title: Day 3.1 Verify Day 2 remote SHA and existing source
steps.why: Confirm the runtime-diagnostics build is the starting point for the launcher-contract work.

steps.title: Day 3.2 Read startup mode from String[] args
steps.why: Give String[] args a real use by accepting the survey-import startup mode from the command line.

steps.title: Day 3.3 Add a controlled main-method contract probe
steps.why: Create a separate probe so launcher experiments do not damage the production application class.

steps.title: Day 3.4 Prove the launcher selects main(String[])
steps.why: Run the probe and observe that Java selects the String[] signature as the launch entry point.

steps.title: Day 3.5 Prove main() can be overloaded but overload is manual
steps.why: Use the probe output to show that the overloaded main(String) executes only because main(String[]) calls it explicitly.

steps.title: Day 3.6 Reproduce non-static and non-public launcher failures
steps.why: Use controlled broken launcher experiments to observe why the standard main method must be public and static.

data.output: Error: Main method is not static in class MainWithoutStatic

steps.title: Day 3.7 Reproduce static-main @Override compiler failure
steps.why: Compile a probe showing that a static main method cannot override an instance method.

data.output: error: static methods cannot be annotated with @Override

steps.title: Day 3.8 Inspect Java 8 class version and method signatures
steps.why: Use javap to confirm class-file version 52 and inspect both legal main overload signatures.

data.output: major version: 52\npublic static void main(java.lang.String[]);\npublic static void main(java.lang.String);

steps.title: Day 3.9 Update question coverage
steps.why: Record the launcher-contract questions as primary coverage only once.

steps.title: Day 3.10 Commit, push, and verify remote state
steps.why: Use the final Day 3 commit as the only starting point for Day 4.
